text: Inside the royal court, some counselors urged caution, fearing retaliation from the newly constructed garrison across the water.
Queen Yanmey stood before the assembly, her indigo shawl pinned with heavy silver rosettes.
'If we allow one ship to break our law today,' she spoke with calm authority, 'tomorrow twenty ships will sail through our living rooms and call it their highway.
Nuimi has ruled these waters since the days of Sundiata.
We do not ask for gifts; we collect the legitimate toll of our ancestors' soil.'
